name: auto_cooldown_under_latched_freeze
description: ANH-189, the programme's own descent under a LATCHED FREEZE: the shipped 30-min programme, the control loop stalls 1.4 s in the middle of HOLD (loop_stall, which latches), and nobody asks for a stop. The setpoint is held to the end of HOLD. From the entry into COOLDOWN at 1260 s it must walk down on the ordinary ramp, still under the FREEZE, and the session must be over at its planned 1800 s as a programme run to its end. The verdict is acknowledged at 1840 s, past the 1830 s at which session_overrun judges a session still in progress: that rule must stay silent, and nothing may move.
